question: Under Directive 2012/18/EU rules on major-accident hazards involving dangerous substances, how do the Commission’s assessment role and a Member State’s notification role compare when a particular dangerous substance may not present a major-accident hazard?

That assessment shall take into account the information referred to in paragraph 3, and shall be based on one or more of the following characteristics:

(a)

(b)

(c)
the maximum concentration of the substances in the case of mixtures.
